full_text_assessment.Timans: Published 23-page PDF reviewed: Sections 2-4 and 6, Appendix C and Table 1. Losses are observed, the null bounds conditional expected loss, and the time-uniform guarantee is per fixed decision threshold. Table 1 supplies the stated single-row-batch/50-step-window delay example.
full_text_assessment.Schirmer: Published NeurIPS 2025 PDF retained and key methods/evaluation/limitations sections examined. Adapted-model running risk, proxy-error separability and threshold calibration differ from the frozen complete-label cohort estimand; not added to the ten-study selection.
full_text_assessment.WATCH: Published ICML 2025 record and PDF retained for contextual screening. Adaptive weighted-conformal diagnostics are outside the fixed-interval gate contrast; no numerical findings imported into the submission.
full_text_assessment.Badea_2026_candidate: Earlier publisher retrieval returned HTTP 429. Follow-up retrieved and retained the full article XML from the official Europe PMC endpoint; Introduction, Methods 3.1-3.8, Discussion 5.1-5.6 and limitations were reviewed. Added as supporting construct-validity context, not an eleventh selected paper. No journal-quartile claim or numerical project comparison is imported.
full_text_assessment.PRODEM: Official ECML PKDD-hosted author PDF retained and reviewed: data, frozen XGBoost/meta-model construction, Tables 1-2 and Eqs. 17-18. Eq. 17 label access was visually checked. Quantitative claims are explicitly tied to this reviewed author version; the publisher confirms conference-paper status and metadata.
